required: maximum two tonal planes per material
strong negative space around arms, legs, weapons and accessories
consistent visual weight with the rest of the roster
forbidden: bloom, lens flare or realistic glow (any glow is a flat solid shape)
jackCheck: Would the silhouette remain recognizable if filled entirely with black?
Could the character be animated using relatively few large shapes?
Is the design readable at thumbnail size?
Are the colors flat and intentionally separated?
Is the character distinctive without relying on elaborate surface details?

shape.tank: wide blocky rectangles and a big shield shape
shape.bruiser: heavy trapezoids, oversized fists and shoulders
shape.fighter: balanced diagonals with one clear weapon line
shape.assassin: sharp triangles, long thin blades, a low coiled posture
shape.caster: flowing diamonds and a bright flat focus shape
shape.blaster: long straight lines and a bold wedge-shaped weapon
shape.controller: hexagons and wide arc gestures with tools hanging off the body
shape.support: soft rounded rectangles with an open palm and a visible kit
shape.enchanter: circles and stars around a charm, instrument or talisman
